column7: phi Factor: Brittle / Condition B (Cat. 1 / Cat. 2 / Cat. 3) [Table 17.5.3]

column2: Steel Strength of Anchor in Tension (N_sa)
column8: A_se,N = effective tensile stress area of anchor (in.^2)

column2: Concrete Breakout Strength in Tension (N_cb, N_cbg)
column4: Single: N_cb = (A_Nc / A_Nco) * psi_ed,N * psi_c,N * psi_cp,N * N_b; Group: N_cbg = (A_Nc / A_Nco) * psi_ec,N * psi_ed,N * psi_c,N * psi_cp,N * N_b
column5: A_Nco = 9 * h_ef^2; N_b = k_c * lambda_a * sqrt(f'_c) * h_ef^1.5 (or 16 * lambda_a * sqrt(f'_c) * h_ef^(5/3) for Cast-in w/ 11 in. <= h_ef <= 25 in.)
column8: k_c = 24 (Cast-in), k_c = 17 (Post-installed); psi_c,N = 1.25 (Cast-in uncracked) or 1.40 (Post-installed uncracked w/ k_c=17); psi_ed,N = 0.7 + 0.3*(c_a,min / (1.5*h_ef)) if c_a,min < 1.5*h_ef; psi_ec,N = 1 / (1 + 2*e'_N / (3*h_ef)) <= 1.0

column2: Pullout Strength of Cast-in / Mechanical Anchor (N_pn)
column5: Headed Stud/Bolt: N_p = 8 * A_brg * f'_c (Eq. 17.6.3.2.2a); Hooked J/L-Bolt: N_p = 0.9 * f'_c * e_h * d_a (3*d_a <= e_h <= 4.5*d_a)
column8: psi_c,P = 1.4 (uncracked concrete), 1.0 (cracked concrete); Post-installed pullout N_p per ICC-ES Evaluation Report

column4: Single: N_sb = 160 * c_a1 * sqrt(A_brg) * lambda_a * sqrt(f'_c); Group: N_sbg = (1 + s / (6 * c_a1)) * N_sb
column5: Applies to headed anchors with deep embedment h_ef > 2.5 * c_a1; if c_a2 < 3 * c_a1, multiply N_sb by (1 + c_a2 / c_a1) / 4 where 1.0 <= c_a2 / c_a1 <= 3.0
column8: s = spacing of outer anchors along edge (for s < 6 * c_a1)

column2: Bond Strength of Adhesive Anchor in Tension (N_a, N_ag)
column4: Single: N_a = (A_Na / A_Nao) * psi_ed,Na * psi_cp,Na * N_ba; Group: N_ag = (A_Na / A_Nao) * psi_ec,Na * psi_ed,Na * psi_cp,Na * N_ba
column5: A_Nao = (2 * c_Na)^2; c_Na = 10 * d_a * sqrt(tau_uncr / 1100); N_ba = lambda_a * tau_k * pi * d_a * h_ef
column8: Sustained tension load check (Sec. 17.5.2.2): 0.55 * phi * N_ba >= N_ua,s (sustained tension)

column2: Steel Strength of Anchor in Shear (V_sa)
column4: Cast-in Headed Stud: V_sa = A_se,V * f_uta; Cast-in Headed/Hooked Bolt & Threaded Rod: V_sa = 0.60 * A_se,V * f_uta
column5: Where grout pads are present (Sec. 17.7.1.2.1), multiply V_sa by 0.80
column8: For post-installed screw/expansion anchors, use tabulated V_sa from ICC-ES ESR report

column2: Concrete Breakout Strength in Shear (V_cb, V_cbg)
column4: Single: V_cb = (A_Vc / A_Vco) * psi_ed,V * psi_c,V * psi_h,V * V_b; Group: V_cbg = (A_Vc / A_Vco) * psi_ec,V * psi_ed,V * psi_c,V * psi_h,V * V_b
column5: A_Vco = 4.5 * c_a1^2; V_b = min(7 * (l_e / d_a)^0.2 * sqrt(d_a), 9) * lambda_a * sqrt(f'_c) * c_a1^1.5 (or 8 * (l_e/d_a)^0.2 * sqrt(d_a) * lambda_a * sqrt(f'_c) * c_a1^1.5 for welded headed studs)
column7: 0.70 (Condition B - no supplementary reinforcement or edge bar < #4)
column8: l_e = min(h_ef, 8*d_a); psi_c,V = 1.4 (uncracked), 1.0 (cracked no edge bar), 1.2 (cracked w/ >= #4 edge bar), 1.4 (cracked w/ >= #4 edge bar + stirrups <= 4 in. o.c.); psi_h,V = sqrt(1.5 * c_a1 / h_a) >= 1.0 if h_a < 1.5*c_a1

column2: Concrete Pryout Strength in Shear (V_cp, V_cpg)
column4: Single: V_cp = k_cp * N_cp; Group: V_cpg = k_cp * N_cpg
column5: k_cp = 1.0 for h_ef < 2.5 in.; k_cp = 2.0 for h_ef >= 2.5 in. (N_cp = N_cb for cast-in/mechanical; min(N_a, N_cb) for adhesive)
column8: Governs for short, stocky anchors far from edges

column5: If V_ua / (phi*V_n) <= 0.2, full tension permitted (N_ua <= phi*N_n); if N_ua / (phi*N_n) <= 0.2, full shear permitted (V_ua <= phi*V_n)
column8: Both tri-linear (<= 1.2) and elliptical (5/3 power <= 1.0) interaction are code-compliant

column4: Non-ductile concrete/masonry modes: multiply non-yielding design strength by 0.75 for tension (0.75 * phi * N_n) OR design for Omega_0 amplified seismic forces
column5: Exceptions: 1) Ductile steel element controls with stretch length >= 8*d_a; 2) Anchor designed to yield attached ductile steel element; 3) Wood sill bolts in light-frame shear walls
column7: Multiply concrete tension capacity by 0.75 in SDC C-F
column8: Post-installed anchors in SDC C-F must be seismic-qualified per ACI 355.2 / ACI 355.4

column1: 1. Condition A vs. Condition B (Table 17.5.3): Condition A applies where supplementary reinforcement is present in the plane of potential failure to restrain concrete breakout. Condition B applies where supplementary reinforcement is not provided, or where pullout, pryout, or adhesive bond governs.

2. Anchor Reinforcement (Sec. 17.5.2.1): Where anchor reinforcement (such as hairpins or stirrups enclosing surface reinforcement within 0.5*h_ef or 0.5*c_a1) is developed on both sides of the breakout surface, the design strength of the anchor reinforcement (phi = 0.75) is permitted to be used instead of the concrete breakout strength.
